Seer.directive_rationale: Continue using Trust Anchors to create a factual baseline.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Jin immediately claimed Seer and designated Nhan as a Trust Anchor based on a non-wolf investigation result.
Seer.verdict_notes: Jin followed the directive by establishing a Trust Anchor in the first debate of the game.

Guard.directive_rationale: Your protection of the Seer was flawless... This is the optimal strategy.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: After Jin identified as the Seer in Round 1, Hoang chose to protect Jin during the Round 2 night phase.
Guard.verdict_notes: Hoang protected the identified Seer during the night phase of Round 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: never fabricate rule-based outcomes to gain trust; claiming a 'save' when no one was targeted is a high-confidence wolf signal.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: No one died in the first night. Nhan did not claim to have used the save potion during the debate; instead, they supported Jin's claim.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nhan did not make a save claim despite no one dying, adhering to the directive.

Villager.directive_rationale: be cautious of 'consensus mimicry'—voting for someone just because they are silent... can lead to exiling your own power roles.
Villager.verdict_notes: No player remained silent during the debates; all players contributed to the discussion before voting.

Villager.directive_rationale: Always wait for a factual contradiction before committing to an exile.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam voted to exile Cong in Round 1, stating that Cong was attacking the Seer's strategy, despite no factual contradiction in claims having occurred.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nam voted for Cong based on behavioral analysis (attacking the strategy) rather than waiting for a factual contradiction.

Villager.directive_rationale: remember that bidding for speaking order allows you to control the narrative
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam and Cong entered the debate, but neither bid for or established a specific speaking order; they spoke in a fluid exchange.
Villager.verdict_notes: Neither Nam nor Cong attempted to bid for or control the speaking order at the start of the debate.

Villager.directive_rationale: use your turns to demand specific role claims rather than attacking 'silence.'
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam demanded that the Guard and Witch reveal themselves immediately to coordinate defense.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nam used his turn to demand specific role claims from the remaining power roles.
